definitions.full: H2879. tabbachah [ טַבָּחָה ] noun feminine female cook ; — only plural absolute טַבָּחוֺת 1Sam 8:13 (+ רַקָּחוֺת perfumers and אֹפוֺת bakers , all as menials).

occurrences.englishText: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.
